Name: Migron
Description: The place at the edge of Gibeah where Saul tarried under a pomegranate tree with his six hundred men, and through which the Assyrian army later passed on its march from Aiath toward Michmash.
BiblicalSignificance: Migron frames two armies: Saul's small band waiting under the pomegranate, and Isaiah's vision of Assyria's advance laying up its carriages at Michmash just beyond.
